description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance (Accuracy %) and token count for four reasoning methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across four benchmarks, as reported in the paper “Efficient Reasoning via Chain of Unconscious Thought.” The left y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 70 to 100 with major tick marks at intervals of 5, while the right y-axis, labeled “Token Count”, ranges from 0 to 800 with major tick marks at intervals of 100. The x-axis displays the four methods: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green), with each method represented by two adjacent bars—one for accuracy (left-side scale) and one for token count (right-side scale). CoT achieves the highest accuracy at 91.19% and also incurs the highest token cost at 676.85. CoD has the lowest accuracy at 80.89% and a moderate token count of 534.24. CCoT achieves 88.50% accuracy with 445.91 tokens, while CoUT achieves 88.40% accuracy with the lowest token count of 354.46. The chart visually emphasizes CoUT’s efficiency, delivering near-parity in accuracy with CCoT while using significantly fewer tokens, and highlights CoT’s high performance at the cost of computational expense.
